items.title: U.S. appeals court upholds designation of Anthropic as supply chain risk
items.title_zh: 美国上诉法院维持五角大楼对 Anthropic 的供应链风险认定
items.title_en: U.S. Appeals Court Upholds Pentagon's Supply-Chain Risk Label on Anthropic
items.summary: A U.S. appeals court upheld the designation of Anthropic as a supply chain risk, raising major implications for AI companies working with the government.

items.title: Platform-independent SIMD in Go
items.title_zh: Go 团队提出平台无关 SIMD 实验性设计
items.title_en: Go Team Proposes Platform-Independent SIMD Experiment
items.summary: The Go team published an experimental design for portable, platform-independent SIMD in Go, prompting strong community discussion about benchmarks, non-fixed-width vector ISA support, and comparisons with C++ std::simd.

items.title: The Chinese AI Infrastructure Boom: Introducing the SemiAnalysis China Datacenter Model
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis 推出中国数据中心模型，覆盖逾 1000 个 AI 基础设施
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis Launches China Datacenter Model Mapping 1,000+ AI Facilities
items.summary: SemiAnalysis introduces a China datacenter model mapping over 1,000 AI infrastructure facilities and key hyperscaler leasing dynamics.
